sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose в or на for each location
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите в или на для каждого места

items.prompt: Мы ужинаем _____ ресторане. (We're having dinner at a restaurant.)
items.promptEnglish: We're having dinner at a restaurant.
items.hint: A restaurant is an enclosed building.
items.explanation: В ресторане: restaurants are enclosed buildings, so use в.

items.prompt: Она _____ выставке. (She's at an exhibition.)
items.promptEnglish: She's at an exhibition.
items.explanation: На выставке: exhibitions are events/activities, so use на.

items.prompt: Дети играют _____ площадке. (The children play on the playground.)
items.promptEnglish: The children play on the playground.
items.hint: A playground is an open area.
items.explanation: На площадке: open outdoor areas use на.

items.prompt: Папа _____ гараже. (Dad is in the garage.)
items.promptEnglish: Dad is in the garage.
items.hint: A garage is an enclosed space.
items.explanation: В гараже: enclosed spaces use в.

items.prompt: Он сидит _____ заводе. (He's at the factory.)
items.promptEnglish: He's at the factory.
items.explanation: На заводе: завод is a fixed expression with на.

items.prompt: Мы были _____ музее вчера. (We were at the museum yesterday.)
items.promptEnglish: We were at the museum yesterday.
items.explanation: В музее: museums are enclosed buildings, so use в.

items.prompt: Студенты _____ экзамене. (The students are at the exam.)
items.promptEnglish: The students are at the exam.
items.explanation: На экзамене: events and academic activities use на.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: В or На for these places?

blanks: Мы отдыхаем _____ море. (We're vacationing at the sea.)
Она учится _____ университете. (She studies at the university.)
Он работает _____ фабрике. (He works at the factory.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: В for enclosed buildings, на for open areas and fixed expressions
hints: The sea is an open area.
explanations: На море: open areas/bodies of water use на.
В университете: enclosed buildings use в.
На фабрике: like на заводе, factory workplaces use на.

sets.title: From Where?
sets.description: Match the 'from' preposition to the destination: из with в, с with на
sets.descriptionRussian: Подберите предлог «откуда»: из к «в», с к «на»

items.prompt: Он идёт _____ школы. (He's coming from school.)
items.promptEnglish: He's coming from school.
items.explanation: В школу → из школы. В-destinations pair with из for 'from.'

items.prompt: Она едет _____ работы. (She's coming from work.)
items.promptEnglish: She's coming from work.
items.explanation: На работу → с работы. На-destinations pair with с for 'from.'

items.prompt: Мы вернулись _____ вокзала. (We returned from the train station.)
items.promptEnglish: We returned from the train station.
items.explanation: На вокзал → с вокзала. На-words pair with с.

items.prompt: Дети идут _____ магазина. (The children are coming from the store.)
items.promptEnglish: The children are coming from the store.
items.explanation: В магазин → из магазина. В-words pair with из.

minimalPairs.context: Он идёт _____ концерта. (He's coming from the concert.)
Он идёт _____ кино. (He's coming from the cinema.)
Она вернулась _____ почты. (She returned from the post office.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She returned from the post office.

minimalPairs.context: Она вернулась _____ аптеки. (She returned from the pharmacy.)

errorCorrection.hint: Work uses на, so 'from' pairs with с.
errorCorrection.explanation: На работе → с работы, not из работы. На pairs with с.

errorCorrection.hint: Store uses в, so 'from' pairs with из.
errorCorrection.explanation: В магазине → из магазина, not с магазина. В pairs with из.

errorCorrection.hint: Library uses в, so 'from' pairs with из.
errorCorrection.explanation: В библиотеке → из библиотеки. В-words pair with из.

sets.title: Direction vs Location
sets.description: Choose the right case: accusative for direction, prepositional for location
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный падеж: винительный для направления, предложный для места

items.prompt: Я иду _____ . (I'm going TO the store.)
items.promptEnglish: I'm going to the store.
items.explanation: Direction: в + accusative. Магазин (inanimate masc) = same form in accusative.

items.prompt: Я покупаю продукты _____ . (I buy groceries AT the store.)
items.promptEnglish: I buy groceries at the store.
items.explanation: Location: в + prepositional. Магазин → в магазине.

items.prompt: Мы едем _____ . (We're going TO the station.)
items.promptEnglish: We're going to the station.
items.hint: Station uses на. Direction = на + accusative.
items.explanation: Вокзал is a на-word. Direction: на + accusative = на вокзал.

translation.english: I'm going to the post office.
translation.hint: Post office uses на. Direction = на + accusative.
Bank is a building = в. Location = в + prepositional.
Factory uses на, so 'from' = с + genitive.

sets.title: Fixed Expressions
sets.description: Practice the fixed на-destinations that must be memorized

patternRecognition.sentence: на работе, на почте, на вокзале, на заводе, на станции, на фабрике
patternRecognition.question: These places are all buildings, yet they use на instead of в. Why?
options: They are fixed expressions that must be memorized individually
patternRecognition.answer: They are fixed expressions that must be memorized individually
patternRecognition.explanation: Some buildings historically used на (from open-air origins). These are fixed expressions - no rule predicts them, they must be learned as vocabulary.

patternRecognition.sentence: на уроке, на лекции, на экзамене, на собрании, на концерте
patternRecognition.question: What do all these на-expressions have in common?
options: They are all events or organized activities
patternRecognition.answer: They are all events or organized activities
patternRecognition.explanation: Events, classes, meetings, and performances consistently use на. This is a reliable pattern you can apply to new event words.

items.prompt: Она была _____ станции метро. (She was at the metro station.)
items.promptEnglish: She was at the metro station.
items.explanation: На станции: all types of stations use на.

items.prompt: Мы встретились _____ аэропорту. (We met at the airport.)
items.promptEnglish: We met at the airport.
items.explanation: В аэропорту: airports use в (enclosed terminal building).

items.prompt: Он сейчас _____ собрании. (He's at a meeting right now.)
items.promptEnglish: He's at a meeting right now.
items.hint: A meeting is an organized event.
items.explanation: На собрании: meetings are events/activities, so use на.

blanks: Дедушка лежит _____ больнице. (Grandpa is in the hospital.)
Мы _____ даче на выходных. (We're at the dacha on weekends.)
Он _____ совещании до трёх. (He's in a meeting until three.)
Цветы _____ вазе. (The flowers are in a vase.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Fixed expressions and general rules for в/на
hints: A vase is an enclosed container.
explanations: В больнице: hospitals are buildings, use в.
На даче: fixed expression with на.
В вазе: enclosed containers use в.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All в/на patterns in one final round

items.prompt: Я забыл телефон _____ работе. (I forgot my phone at work.)
items.promptEnglish: I forgot my phone at work.
items.explanation: На работе: work is a fixed на-expression.

items.prompt: Дети вернулись _____ школы. (The children returned from school.)
items.promptEnglish: The children returned from school.
items.explanation: В школе → из школы. В-places pair with из.

items.prompt: Мы живём _____ Петербурге. (We live in St. Petersburg.)
items.promptEnglish: We live in St. Petersburg.
items.explanation: В Петербурге: cities consistently use в.

errorCorrection.hint: Stadium uses на, so 'from' = с (со before ст-).
errorCorrection.explanation: На стадионе → со стадиона. На-words pair with с/со. Со is used before ст- clusters.
В театр, not на театр. Theaters are enclosed buildings and use в.
В больнице → из больницы. В-places pair with из, not с.
